email_draft.subject: Bayou Parish's RFI scoped in time, by Journify
email_draft.body:
Bayou Parish School Board posted an RFI on April 8 seeking software for IEP management, progress monitoring, and federal reporting, with responses due May 15.

With roughly 1,700 students on IEPs, your case managers and related-service providers are carrying a documentation load that touches every one of those areas the RFI named. Journify integrates directly with Frontline IEP and Louisiana state-linked systems, so your team keeps what it has and cuts IEP materials generation to under five minutes per student. That means federal and LDOE compliance reporting gets done faster, and your team's afternoons go to students instead of screens.

Should I get a scoped response in front of your committee well before May 15, or would a 20-minute call this week help frame the requirements first?
